home.title: Imarika: weather forecasts for farmers in Busia County
home.hero_title: Know when the rain is coming.
home.hero_text: Weather forecasts for farmers in Busia County, from weather stations in your own area.
home.step1_text: Weather stations in your area measure rain, temperature, humidity and wind every few minutes.
home.step2_text: Imarika uses these readings to forecast rain and temperature for each of the next seven days.
home.step3_title: Advice reaches you by web and SMS
home.step3_text: You get plain advice about rain, planting and spraying on this website or by text message.
home.read_more: Read more about how it works
home.stations_text: Each dot is one weather station. The colour shows what the coming week looks like there.
home.stations_map_label: Map of Busia County with its weather stations
home.contact_text: We would like to hear from farmers, extension officers and anyone else who uses Imarika.

how.title: How it works
how.lead: Imarika turns readings from weather stations near your farm into simple advice for the week.
how.steps_title: From weather station to your phone
how.step1: Weather stations in Busia County measure rain, temperature, humidity and wind all day.
how.step2: We clean the readings and check them, so faulty values are not used.
how.step3: A forecasting model uses past readings to predict the next 7 days.
how.step4: Simple rules turn the forecast into advice about rain, planting and spraying.
how.step5: The advice reaches farmers on this website and by text message.
how.words_title: What the colours and words mean
how.words_intro: Every station gets one word for the coming week. The colour and the icon always match the word.
how.station_alt: Illustration of a weather station standing in a maize field
how.do_warning: If you are in a flood-prone area, move to higher ground.
how.do_watch: Clear drains and avoid low-lying fields.
how.do_planting: Rain may suit planting. Dry spells after the next 7 days are not checked.
how.do_delay: Delay spraying and harvesting on the rainy days.
how.do_none: No rain alerts for this station this week.
how.do_offline: This station sends no data, so there is no forecast. Check a nearby station.
how.sure_1: Forecasts for the next few days are more certain than forecasts for later in the week.
how.sure_2: Rain is harder to predict than temperature, so treat rain amounts as a guide.
how.sure_3: A station that stops sending data shows as Not reporting and gets no forecast.
how.about_1: Imarika is a final-year project at Strathmore University by Philip Tait Lemaron.
how.about_2: Weather station data comes from the iLabAfrica Anga Weather Network.
